confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge, not from live listings or menus. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately confident. Hotel and hostel anchors are less certain because July is peak season and prices vary widely by location and availability. Tel Aviv prices are set in NIS and converted at roughly 3.3 to 3.7 NIS per USD. FX provenance: the 0.6955 figure comes from a search summary that says it is the RBA's 4.00 pm observation for 15 October 2026. I did not open the RBA page directly, so verify it. A third-party site reported 0.6947 for 16 October 2026, but I could not confirm that on rba.gov.au and did not use it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against Israeli coastal-city price levels and against restaurant and cafe prices in Western European capitals. Tel Aviv costs are well above most Middle Eastern cities. Accommodation is priced for summer peak demand.
